title: Console API: expose Optimize guardrails gating run summary + artifact links
author: Chloe Martin
release_notes: Internal Console API: add read endpoints for guardrails gating run summaries + artifact links used by the Optimize apply UI.
body:
Context: The Optimize apply flow is being gated on guardrails evals. The Console UI needs a single read-only endpoint to fetch (a) a concise gating run summary (status + metric deltas) and (b) artifact links (JSON/HTML reports) for a given run, without the frontend needing to talk directly to Guardrails/EvalRunner services.

What’s in this PR: Adds Console backend endpoints that proxy guardrails gating run summaries and resolve artifact links into time-limited signed URLs suitable for the UI. Also adds RBAC + tenant isolation checks, response shaping for UI-friendly display, and a small in-memory cache to keep the UI from spamming Guardrails during refresh.

API (internal, Console backend): 1) GET /console/api/v1/optimize/gating-runs/{gating_run_id} -> returns GatingRunSummary + artifacts, including: gating_run_id, tenant_id (omitted from response but used for authz), optimize_apply_id (if present), status (QUEUED|RUNNING|PASS|FAIL|TIMEOUT|ERROR), started_at/finished_at, suite_id + suite_rev, prompt_set_id + prompt_set_rev, model_id + model_version, config_delta_hash, metrics[] (flattened list of metric_name, baseline, candidate, delta, threshold, pass, ci_low, ci_high), failure_reasons[] (string codes), artifacts[] (name + signed_url + content_type + expires_at).

2) GET /console/api/v1/optimize/apply/{apply_id}/gating-runs -> lists gating runs for a single apply attempt (newest first), intended for the "Gating results" panel history.

Artifact link handling: Guardrails stores artifact URIs (gs:// / s3:// / internal artifact store). This endpoint converts those into signed HTTPS URLs (15 min TTL). IMPORTANT: we do not return raw bucket/object keys to the client. The signing happens server-side and is scoped to tenant + run_id.

Authz + isolation: Requires Console session with optimize:read (existing permission). On the server side we enforce tenant match between Console request context and the Guardrails gating run record. If there’s a mismatch we return 404 (not 403) to avoid resource enumeration.

Caching: Adds a short (30s) cache keyed by (tenant_id, gating_run_id) to reduce repeated reads during UI polling/refresh. The cache is bypassed for terminal states older than 10 minutes (we always go to source-of-truth for older runs to avoid stale artifact URLs).

Tests: Unit tests for response shaping (metric ordering determinism), tenant isolation, and artifact signing. Integration test uses a mocked GuardrailsClient to validate that the UI will always receive stable metric ordering + consistent failure reason codes.

Example response (abbrev): {"gating_run_id":"gr_01H...","status":"FAIL","metrics":[{"metric_name":"rubric.overall","baseline":0.812,"candidate":0.771,"delta":-0.041,"threshold":-0.020,"pass":false,"ci_low":-0.055,"ci_high":-0.028}],"failure_reasons":["THRESHOLD_VIOLATION"],"artifacts":[{"name":"summary.json","signed_url":"https://artifacts...","expires_at":"2025-01-20T19:02:11Z"}]}.

Notes / follow-ups: This intentionally does not expose per-prompt raw outputs in the default response. Those are available only via artifacts (and remain behind authz) to minimize accidental PII propagation through Console logs. The UI will link to the artifact rather than render raw prompt text inline. Future: add pagination for per-apply history if we see very large apply histories (currently capped server-side at 25 runs).

Refs: ENG-3917 (Console gating results panel). Related: PR #18462 (eval runner persistence model) / PR #18470 (eval caching) / PR #18481 (audit logging).
commits: console-api: add GuardrailsClient methods for gating run fetch + apply->runs list
console-api: add optimize gating run handlers and DTO shaping
security: tenant isolation + RBAC enforcement for gating run reads
artifacts: resolve + sign artifact URLs (15m TTL) with allowlist validation
tests: add unit/integration tests for deterministic metric ordering + 404-on-mismatch
review_conversation:
Ethan Park: Can you confirm this doesn’t let Console read arbitrary gating runs across tenants (esp. if someone guesses IDs)? Also please ensure we don’t return raw artifact URIs.

Chloe Martin (author): Yep. We fetch the run from Guardrails, compare tenant_id from Console auth context to the run’s tenant_id, and return 404 on mismatch. Artifact URIs never go back to the browser; we resolve and return only signed HTTPS URLs with a short TTL.

Benji Okafor: Metric list ordering needs to be deterministic for the UI diff view (we had flakiness elsewhere due to map ordering). Can we sort by metric_name?

Chloe Martin: Done. Added explicit sort on metric_name + included it in tests.

Felix Schneider: For dashboards we’ll likely want failure reason codes stable. Can we document the codes we return and avoid passing through arbitrary strings from Guardrails?

Chloe Martin: Good call. This PR maps Guardrails reason enums -> stable strings (THRESHOLD_VIOLATION, MIN_SAMPLE_SIZE, EVAL_RUNNER_TIMEOUT, ARTIFACTS_UNAVAILABLE, INTERNAL_ERROR). If we see an unknown value we bucket into INTERNAL_ERROR and log server-side only.

Kenji Nakamura: UX note: UI copy wants a single 'artifact link' for “View full report”. Can we include a preferred artifact if present?

Chloe Martin: Added preferred_artifact_name in the response (defaults to html_report if available, else summary.json). Frontend can still show the list in a popover.

Jordan Lee: Cache behavior: careful not to cache signed URLs too long. 30s is fine but make sure the expires_at is passed to client.

Chloe Martin: Included expires_at per artifact. Cache TTL is < URL TTL; and we bypass cache for older terminal runs to refresh URLs.

Approvals: Ethan Park approved (2025-01-20). Benji Okafor approved (2025-01-20). Felix Schneider approved (2025-01-20).
